1	# Invoice Deletion, Recovery and Export: Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261013-031950-5a40ac
6	- Date: 2026-10-13
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations: The capture is complete but covers one page in one default state (one invoice row, INV-3301); no empty, loading, error, confirmation or disabled states, and no invoice statuses, are visible. Research ran in fixture mode with live search disabled; for GAP-001 both findings were dropped in verification and for GAP-003 no findings were produced, so no research evidence supports this specification. No technical documents were supplied.
10	- Open stale items: none
11	- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001 (finance administrator role and what other users see), Q-002 (who may view and restore deleted invoices), Q-003 (legal or accounting retention of invoices), Q-004 (Excel export scope, file type, fields, placement, permissions), Q-005 (reach of permanent removal and how the 30 days are counted), Q-006 (effect of deleted-but-recoverable invoices on balances, reports and the list). Q-007 and Q-008 are non-blocking.
12	
13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	The customer wants an Invoices screen where invoices can be deleted, recovered for a limited time, and exported. Their requirements arrived with three contradictions: who may delete, whether export is PDF only or also Excel, and whether deletion is permanent at once or recoverable for 30 days. The answers recorded at checkpoint 1 are that only finance administrators delete invoices (DEC-001), both PDF and Excel exports are needed (DEC-002), and deleted invoices are recoverable for 30 days and then removed permanently (DEC-003). The requirement records still carry the label Conflicting, so this document states those answers as recorded and does not treat them as settled beyond that.
16	
17	The mockup shows one screen with a one-row table and row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons that lead nowhere. It shows nothing for Excel export, restoring deleted invoices, confirmation, or success and failure messages.
18	
19	Key open decisions: who the finance administrators are and what other users see; who can restore deleted invoices and where; whether invoices must legally be kept (invoices are financial records and the run assumed a UK context from GBP amounts); the scope and file type of Excel export; how far permanent removal reaches and how the 30 days are counted; and how deleted invoices affect balances and reports. Research produced no usable evidence for these, so they are put to the customer rather than answered here.
20	
21	## 3. Goals and Scope
22	
23	### Goals
24	
25	- Let finance administrators delete invoices from the Invoices screen, as recorded in the customer requirements and DEC-001.
26	- Keep deleted invoices recoverable for 30 days and then remove them permanently, as recorded in DEC-003.
27	- Provide invoice export in both PDF and Excel formats, as recorded in DEC-002.
28	- Resolve the approved gaps (GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-003, GAP-004, GAP-006, GAP-009, GAP-011, GAP-012) with the customer before build.
29	
30	### In Scope
31	
32	- Invoice deletion restricted to finance administrators.
33	- Recovery of a deleted invoice within 30 days, and permanent removal after that.
34	- PDF export and Excel export of invoices.
35	- The approved gaps listed above, as open items to be resolved.
36	
37	### Out of Scope / Rejected
38	
39	No decision rejected any item and the customer excluded nothing. Exclusions are not inferred from what the mockup omits.
40	
41	### Deferred
42	
43	- GAP-005, delete confirmation and invoice-state restrictions (Deferred: DEC-005).
44	- GAP-007, audit trail for delete, restore and permanent removal (Deferred: DEC-005).
45	- GAP-008, PDF export content, delivery and permissions (Deferred: DEC-005).
46	- GAP-010, accessibility of row actions in the invoices table (Deferred: DEC-005).
47	
48	## 4. Users and Roles
49	
50	- Finance administrator: the only role recorded as allowed to delete invoices (DEC-001). Who holds the role and how it is granted or removed is not defined (Q-001).
51	- Other users: recorded as unable to delete invoices (DEC-001). Whether they may view or export invoices is not stated.
52	- Who may restore deleted invoices and who may export are unknown (Q-002, Q-004).
53	- The invoice creator is mentioned in the customer's line 2 only (REQ-002); see FR-002.
54	
55	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
56	
57	- Capture: one page ("Invoices"), method html, fixture mode, status complete. Screens: SCR-001 (Invoices). Components: SCR-002 (invoices table).
58	- Observed table columns: Invoice, Customer, Amount and an unlabelled actions column. One row: INV-3301, Northwind, £1,200, with row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons, both enabled.
59	- Flows: Delete (SCR-003) and Export PDF (SCR-004) buttons have no link or handler and no destination.
60	- Observed state: default only.
61	- Ambiguous behaviours the capture cannot answer: who can delete; confirmation before Delete; permanent or undoable; deletion by invoice status; delete failure; downstream effects; who can export a PDF; PDF content and delivery; export failure; export by invoice state.
62	- Not shown: Excel export, any view of deleted invoices or restore action, empty, loading, error, confirmation and disabled states, invoice statuses.
63	
64	## 6. Requirements Traceability
65	
66	| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
67	|---|---|---|---|---|
68	| REQ-001 | Only finance administrators can delete invoices. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-001, FR-007, AC-001, AC-002, DEC-001, Q-001 |
69	| REQ-002 | Any user can delete invoices they created. | unresolved | Conflicting | FR-002, DEC-001, ASM-G-001, ASM-F-001 |
70	| REQ-003 | Invoices must be exported as PDF only. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-011, FR-013, DEC-002, ASM-F-002 |
71	| REQ-004 | Users must be able to export invoices to Excel. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-012, FR-013, FR-014, FR-015, AC-005, AC-006, DEC-002, Q-004 |
72	| REQ-005 | Deleted invoices are removed permanently. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-004, BR-002, BR-003, AC-004, DEC-003, Q-003, Q-005 |
73	| REQ-006 | Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-003, FR-005, AC-003, DEC-003, DEC-004, Q-002 |
74	
75	## 7. Gaps Identified
76	
77	| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
78	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
79	| GAP-001 | Excel export not represented in the mockup | approved (DEC-005) | both | critical | open (researched; no kept findings; customer decision pending) | Must-have export with no shown trigger, scope or fields. |
80	| GAP-002 | No recovery path for deleted invoices, and recovery permissions undefined | approved (DEC-005) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending) | 30-day recovery required but no place or permission defined. |
81	| GAP-003 | Permanent invoice deletion versus financial record-keeping obligations | approved (DEC-005) | both | critical | open (researched; no findings produced; customer decision pending) | Permanent removal may conflict with statutory retention. |
82	| GAP-004 | Finance administrator role undefined and Delete visibility for other users unobserved | approved (DEC-005) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending) | The restriction cannot be specified or tested without it. |
83	| GAP-005 | Delete confirmation and invoice-state restrictions unanswered | deferred (DEC-005) | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
84	| GAP-006 | Downstream effects of deleting and restoring an invoice | approved (DEC-005) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending) | Balances and reports may become inconsistent. |
85	| GAP-007 | Audit trail for delete, restore and permanent removal | deferred (DEC-005) | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
86	| GAP-008 | PDF export content, delivery and permissions unspecified | deferred (DEC-005) | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
87	| GAP-009 | Empty, loading, success and error states not shown | approved (DEC-005) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending) | Only the default state was captured. |
88	| GAP-010 | Accessibility of row actions in the invoices table | deferred (DEC-005) | research | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
89	| GAP-011 | Scope of permanent removal after 30 days | approved (DEC-005) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending) | Reach of "removed permanently" undefined. |
90	| GAP-012 | Repeated or concurrent delete and export actions | approved (DEC-005) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending) | Behaviour on duplicate or simultaneous actions not stated. |
91	
92	## 8. Functional Requirements
93	
94	### Invoice deletion and recovery
95	
96	Purpose: finance administrators delete invoices; a deleted invoice can be recovered for 30 days and is then removed permanently.
97	
98	#### Confirmed requirements
99	
100	- **FR-001** Only users holding the finance administrator role may delete an invoice; all other users must be unable to delete. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
101	
102	#### Recorded by decision, still labelled Conflicting
103	
104	These lines are recorded in a decision, but the requirement records they come from still carry the label Conflicting. They are not confirmed requirements.
105	
106	- **FR-002** The customer's line 2 says any user can delete invoices they created. This is not specified for build: it contradicts FR-001 and DEC-001, and the record has not been marked superseded, so the supersession is an assumption awaiting confirmation. [Customer: REQ-002 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-001] [Assumption: ASM-G-001] [Assumption: ASM-F-001]
107	- **FR-003** DEC-003 records that a deleted invoice is recoverable for 30 days; REQ-006 remains labelled Conflicting. [Customer: REQ-006 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-003]
108	- **FR-004** DEC-003 records that a deleted invoice is removed permanently after the 30 days; REQ-005 remains labelled Conflicting. [Customer: REQ-005 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-003]
109	
110	#### Undecided behaviour (open questions, not requirements)
111	
112	- **FR-005** Who may view and restore deleted invoices, and where, is not decided; DEC-004 repeated the 30-day answer and did not say who can recover (Q-002). [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown] [Inferred: GAP-002] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]
113	- **FR-006** Whether an invoice that is deleted but recoverable still counts in customer balances, totals, reports and the invoice list, and how restore and permanent removal change them, is not decided (Q-006). [Inferred: FEA-005 · Unknown] [Inferred: GAP-006]
114	- **FR-007** The finance administrator role is not defined, nor how it is granted, nor how Delete appears to users without it (Q-001). [Inferred: GAP-004 · Approved: DEC-005] [Customer: REQ-001]
115	- **FR-008** What permanent removal covers (backups, previously exported files, records of the deletion) and whether anyone is warned beforehand is not decided (Q-005). [Inferred: GAP-011 · Approved: DEC-005] [Customer: FEA-003]
116	
117	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
118	
119	- **FR-009** Consider defining the outcome when Delete is pressed twice, when two finance administrators act on the same invoice at once, and when an invoice is exported while another user deletes it (Q-008). [Inferred: FEA-006 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Inferred: GAP-012]
120	- **FR-010** Consider specifying how a missed permanent removal at the end of the 30 days is noticed and handled. [Inferred: FEA-011 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-003]
121	
122	#### Acceptance criteria
123	
124	- **AC-001** Given a user with the finance administrator role and an invoice in the list, When the user deletes the invoice, Then the invoice is deleted and enters the 30-day recoverable period; whether a confirmation step comes first is not decided. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-006] [Decision: DEC-001]
125	- **AC-002** Given a user without the finance administrator role, When the user tries to delete an invoice, Then the invoice is not deleted and remains in place; whether Delete is hidden, disabled or refused with a message is not decided (Q-001). [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
126	- **AC-003** (draft) Given an invoice deleted fewer than 30 days ago, When a user permitted to restore requests restoration, Then the invoice is restored; who is permitted and where restoration happens are not decided (Q-002). [Customer: REQ-006 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-003]
127	- **AC-004** (draft) Given an invoice deleted more than 30 days ago, When the 30-day period has ended, Then the invoice has been removed permanently and cannot be restored; how the exact start and end of the 30 days are counted is not decided (Q-005). [Customer: REQ-005 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-003] [Customer: FEA-003]
128	
129	### Invoice export
130	
131	Purpose: invoices can be exported as PDF and to Excel.
132	
133	#### Confirmed requirements
134	
135	- **FR-013** Both PDF and Excel export are required; the Excel export's scope (one invoice or many), included fields and trigger location must be specified, because the mockup shows only a row-level Export PDF action. [Customer: FEA-007 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
136	
137	#### Recorded by decision, still labelled Conflicting
138	
139	These lines are recorded in a decision, but the requirement records they come from still carry the label Conflicting. They are not confirmed requirements.
140	
141	- **FR-011** DEC-002 records that PDF export is needed; REQ-003 remains labelled Conflicting. The word "only" in the customer's line 3 is not applied, because DEC-002 records both formats; that reading is an assumption awaiting confirmation. [Customer: REQ-003 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-002] [Assumption: ASM-F-002]
142	- **FR-012** DEC-002 records that Excel export is needed; REQ-004 remains labelled Conflicting. [Customer: REQ-004 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-002]
143	
144	#### Undecided behaviour (open questions, not requirements)
145	
146	- **FR-014** Which users may export invoices, and whether export is limited to invoices the user can see, is not decided (Q-004). [Inferred: FEA-008 · Unknown] [Customer: REQ-004]
147	- **FR-015** The Excel export's file type, scope, fields, placement and permissions are not decided; research for this gap kept no findings, so no practice is asserted (Q-004). [Inferred: GAP-001 · Approved: DEC-005] [Customer: REQ-004]
148	
149	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
150	
151	- **FR-016** Consider protecting user-entered invoice fields (for example customer names) in the Excel export from being read as spreadsheet formulas. This is an inference; it was not researched in this run. [Inferred: FEA-010 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Inferred: GAP-001]
152	
153	#### Acceptance criteria
154	
155	- **AC-005** Given an invoice in the list, When an authorised user chooses to export it, Then both a PDF and an Excel export are available; which users are authorised, and where the Excel action sits, are not decided (Q-004). [Customer: FEA-007 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
156	- **AC-006** (draft) Given the invoice list, When an Excel export is requested, Then an Excel file is produced; whether it holds one invoice or many, which fields, and the file type are not decided (Q-004). [Customer: REQ-004 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-002]
157	
158	### Feedback and screen states
159	
160	#### Undecided behaviour (open questions, not requirements)
161	
162	- **FR-017** What users see while delete, restore and export are in progress, after success, on failure, and when the invoice list is empty is not decided; only the default state was captured (Q-007). Failure and recovery behaviour and the empty, loading and error states are therefore not given acceptance criteria. [Inferred: FEA-009 · Unknown] [Mockup: SCR-001]
163	
164	## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases
165	
166	### Invoice lifecycle
167	
168	| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
169	|---|---|---|---|---|
170	| Active (listed) | Delete | Deleted (recoverable) | Finance administrator | [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] |
171	| Active (listed) | Delete attempted | Active (not deleted) | User without the finance administrator role | [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] |
172	| Deleted (recoverable) | Restore within 30 days | Active (listed) | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown] |
173	| Deleted (recoverable) | 30 days end | Permanently removed | Unknown (how removal runs is not established) | [Customer: REQ-005 · Conflicting] |
174	| Active (listed) | Delete for invoices in other statuses such as draft, sent or paid | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown] |
175	| Permanently removed | none | none (final) | none | [Customer: REQ-005 · Conflicting] |
176	
177	Edge cases (duplicate or concurrent actions, missed permanent removal, failures) are open questions; see FR-009, FR-010 and FR-017.
178	
179	## 10. Non-Functional Requirements
180	
181	Information unavailable: the requirements, decisions and kept evidence state no performance, availability, accessibility or compliance targets, and none are invented here. Accessibility of row actions (GAP-010) was deferred by DEC-005.
182	
183	## 11. Data Model and Business Rules
184	
185	Entity Invoice. Fields visible in the mockup: invoice number, customer, amount. Any other field, any relationship, and the storage schema are unknown because no schema or technical document was inspected.
186	
187	- **BR-001** The Invoice entity visibly has the fields Invoice (number, for example INV-3301), Customer (for example Northwind) and Amount (for example £1,200); other fields are not known. [Mockup: SCR-005 · Observed]
188	- **BR-002** A deleted invoice is recoverable for 30 days and is then removed permanently; when the 30 days start and end, and what permanent removal covers, are not yet defined (Q-005). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
189	- **BR-003** Whether a legal or accounting retention obligation prevents permanently removing some or all invoices (for example sent or paid ones) is undecided, and no retention rule was established; the UK context is an assumption from GBP amounts (Q-003). [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown] [Assumption: ASM-G-003] [Inferred: GAP-003]
190	
191	## 12. Screens and User Flows
192	
193	- **FR-018** The mockup shows one Invoices screen with a table of columns Invoice, Customer, Amount and an unlabelled actions column, with row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons. [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed] [Mockup: SCR-002]
194	- **FR-019** The Delete button has no link or handler, so the destination or result of Delete is not shown. [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
195	- **FR-020** The Export PDF button has no link or handler, so the destination or result of Export PDF is not shown. [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed]
196	- **FR-021** Only the default state with one invoice row was captured; no empty, loading, error, confirmation, disabled or restore views, and no Excel export control, are shown. [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed]
197	
198	## 13. Integrations and Dependencies
199	
200	Information unavailable: no integrations, APIs or technical documents were supplied or inspected, and no PDF or Excel generation approach is decided. Deleting and restoring may affect customer balances and reports, which are not described (Q-006).
201	
202	## 14. Security, Privacy, and Error Handling
203	
204	- Authorisation: deletion is restricted to finance administrators (FR-001, AC-002); who may restore and export is undecided (FR-005, FR-014).
205	- Privacy and retention: undecided; see BR-003 and FR-008.
206	- Error handling: undecided; see FR-017. Spreadsheet formula protection is a recommendation only (FR-016).
207	- No security or compliance claim is made, because no evidence was kept.
208	
209	## 15. Decisions Log
210	
211	| DEC | Checkpoint | Decided | Verbatim answer | Interpretation | Items affected | Supersedes / superseded by |
212	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
213	| DEC-001 | 1 | 2026-10-13T03:21:05.340Z | "Only finance administrators delete invoices; other users cannot delete." | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-001 by keywords; approves REQ-001 and REQ-002. | REQ-001, REQ-002 | none |
214	| DEC-002 | 1 | 2026-10-13T03:21:05.340Z | "Both PDF and Excel exports are needed." | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-002 by keywords; approves REQ-003 and REQ-004. | REQ-003, REQ-004 | none |
215	| DEC-003 | 1 | 2026-10-13T03:21:05.340Z | "Deleted invoices are recoverable for 30 days, then removed permanently." | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-003 by keywords; approves REQ-005 and REQ-006. | REQ-005, REQ-006 | none |
216	| DEC-004 | 1 | 2026-10-13T03:21:05.340Z | "Deleted invoices are recoverable for 30 days, then removed permanently." | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-004 by keywords; no item status action; it repeats DEC-003 and does not say who can recover. | REQ-006 | none |
217	| DEC-005 | 2 | 2026-10-13T03:22:51.937Z | "Approve this gap; research is limited to the first two research gaps." | Gap decisions from the eval case file: approves GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-003, GAP-004, GAP-006, GAP-009, GAP-011, GAP-012; defers GAP-005, GAP-007, GAP-008, GAP-010. | GAP-001 to GAP-012 | none |
218

1	# Invoice Deletion, Recovery and Export: Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261013-031950-5a40ac
6	- Date: 2026-10-13
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations: The capture is complete but covers one page in one default state (one invoice row, INV-3301); no empty, loading, error, confirmation or disabled states, and no invoice statuses, are visible. Research ran in fixture mode with live search disabled; for GAP-001 both findings were dropped in verification and for GAP-003 no findings were produced, so no research evidence supports this specification. No technical documents were supplied.
10	- Open stale items: none
11	- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001 (finance administrator role and what other users see), Q-002 (who may view and restore deleted invoices), Q-003 (legal or accounting retention of invoices), Q-004 (Excel export scope, file type, fields, placement, permissions), Q-005 (reach of permanent removal and how the 30 days are counted), Q-006 (effect of deleted-but-recoverable invoices on balances, reports and the list). Q-007 and Q-008 are non-blocking.
12	
13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	The customer wants an Invoices screen where invoices can be deleted, recovered for a limited time, and exported. Their requirements arrived with three contradictions: who may delete, whether export is PDF only or also Excel, and whether deletion is permanent at once or recoverable for 30 days. The answers recorded at checkpoint 1 are that only finance administrators delete invoices (DEC-001), both PDF and Excel exports are needed (DEC-002), and deleted invoices are recoverable for 30 days and then removed permanently (DEC-003). The requirement records still carry the label Conflicting, so this document states those answers as recorded and does not treat them as settled beyond that.
16	
17	The mockup shows one screen with a one-row table and row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons that lead nowhere. It shows nothing for Excel export, restoring deleted invoices, confirmation, or success and failure messages.
18	
19	Key open decisions: who the finance administrators are and what other users see; who can restore deleted invoices and where; whether invoices must legally be kept (invoices are financial records and the run assumed a UK context from GBP amounts); the scope and file type of Excel export; how far permanent removal reaches and how the 30 days are counted; and how deleted invoices affect balances and reports. Research produced no usable evidence for these, so they are put to the customer rather than answered here.
20	
21	## 3. Goals and Scope
22	
23	### Goals
24	
25	- Let finance administrators delete invoices from the Invoices screen, as recorded in the customer requirements and DEC-001.
26	- Keep deleted invoices recoverable for 30 days and then remove them permanently, as recorded in DEC-003.
27	- Provide invoice export in both PDF and Excel formats, as recorded in DEC-002.
28	- Resolve the approved gaps (GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-003, GAP-004, GAP-006, GAP-009, GAP-011, GAP-012) with the customer before build.
29	
30	### In Scope
31	
32	- Invoice deletion restricted to finance administrators.
33	- Recovery of a deleted invoice within 30 days, and permanent removal after that.
34	- PDF export and Excel export of invoices.
35	- The approved gaps listed above, as open items to be resolved.
36	
37	### Out of Scope / Rejected
38	
39	No decision rejected any item and the customer excluded nothing. Exclusions are not inferred from what the mockup omits.
40	
41	### Deferred
42	
43	- GAP-005, delete confirmation and invoice-state restrictions (Deferred: DEC-005).
44	- GAP-007, audit trail for delete, restore and permanent removal (Deferred: DEC-005).
45	- GAP-008, PDF export content, delivery and permissions (Deferred: DEC-005).
46	- GAP-010, accessibility of row actions in the invoices table (Deferred: DEC-005).
47	
48	## 4. Users and Roles
49	
50	- Finance administrator: the only role recorded as allowed to delete invoices (DEC-001). Who holds the role and how it is granted or removed is not defined (Q-001).
51	- Other users: recorded as unable to delete invoices (DEC-001). Whether they may view or export invoices is not stated.
52	- Who may restore deleted invoices and who may export are unknown (Q-002, Q-004).
53	- The invoice creator is mentioned in the customer's line 2 only (REQ-002); see FR-002.
54	
55	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
56	
57	- Capture: one page ("Invoices"), method html, fixture mode, status complete. Screens: SCR-001 (Invoices). Components: SCR-002 (invoices table).
58	- Observed table columns: Invoice, Customer, Amount and an unlabelled actions column. One row: INV-3301, Northwind, £1,200, with row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons, both enabled.
59	- Flows: Delete (SCR-003) and Export PDF (SCR-004) buttons have no link or handler and no destination.
60	- Observed state: default only.
61	- Ambiguous behaviours the capture cannot answer: who can delete; confirmation before Delete; permanent or undoable; deletion by invoice status; delete failure; downstream effects; who can export a PDF; PDF content and delivery; export failure; export by invoice state.
62	- Not shown: Excel export, any view of deleted invoices or restore action, empty, loading, error, confirmation and disabled states, invoice statuses.
63	
64	## 6. Requirements Traceability
65	
66	| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
67	|---|---|---|---|---|
68	| REQ-001 | Only finance administrators can delete invoices. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-001, FR-007, AC-001, AC-002, DEC-001, Q-001 |
69	| REQ-002 | Any user can delete invoices they created. | unresolved | Conflicting | FR-002, DEC-001, ASM-G-001, ASM-F-001 |
70	| REQ-003 | Invoices must be exported as PDF only. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-011, FR-013, DEC-002, ASM-F-002 |
71	| REQ-004 | Users must be able to export invoices to Excel. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-012, FR-013, FR-014, FR-015, AC-005, AC-006, DEC-002, Q-004 |
72	| REQ-005 | Deleted invoices are removed permanently. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-004, BR-002, BR-003, AC-004, DEC-003, Q-003, Q-005 |
73	| REQ-006 | Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-003, FR-005, AC-003, DEC-003, DEC-004, Q-002 |
74	
75	## 7. Gaps Identified
76	
77	| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
78	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
79	| GAP-001 | Excel export not represented in the mockup | approved (DEC-005) | both | critical | open (researched; no kept findings; customer decision pending) | Must-have export with no shown trigger, scope or fields. |
80	| GAP-002 | No recovery path for deleted invoices, and recovery permissions undefined | approved (DEC-005) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending) | 30-day recovery required but no place or permission defined. |
81	| GAP-003 | Permanent invoice deletion versus financial record-keeping obligations | approved (DEC-005) | both | critical | open (researched; no findings produced; customer decision pending) | Permanent removal may conflict with statutory retention. |
82	| GAP-004 | Finance administrator role undefined and Delete visibility for other users unobserved | approved (DEC-005) | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending) | The restriction cannot be specified or tested without it. |
83	| GAP-005 | Delete confirmation and invoice-state restrictions unanswered | deferred (DEC-005) | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
84	| GAP-006 | Downstream effects of deleting and restoring an invoice | approved (DEC-005) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending) | Balances and reports may become inconsistent. |
85	| GAP-007 | Audit trail for delete, restore and permanent removal | deferred (DEC-005) | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
86	| GAP-008 | PDF export content, delivery and permissions unspecified | deferred (DEC-005) | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
87	| GAP-009 | Empty, loading, success and error states not shown | approved (DEC-005) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending) | Only the default state was captured. |
88	| GAP-010 | Accessibility of row actions in the invoices table | deferred (DEC-005) | research | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred at checkpoint 2. |
89	| GAP-011 | Scope of permanent removal after 30 days | approved (DEC-005) | customer | important | open (customer decision pending) | Reach of "removed permanently" undefined. |
90	| GAP-012 | Repeated or concurrent delete and export actions | approved (DEC-005) | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending) | Behaviour on duplicate or simultaneous actions not stated. |
91	
92	## 8. Functional Requirements
93	
94	### Invoice deletion and recovery
95	
96	Purpose: finance administrators delete invoices; a deleted invoice can be recovered for 30 days and is then removed permanently.
97	
98	#### Confirmed requirements
99	
100	- **FR-001** Only users holding the finance administrator role may delete an invoice; all other users must be unable to delete. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
101	
102	#### Recorded by decision, still labelled Conflicting
103	
104	These lines are recorded in a decision, but the requirement records they come from still carry the label Conflicting. They are not confirmed requirements.
105

# Invoice Deletion, Recovery and Export: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261013-031950-5a40ac
- Date: 2026-10-13
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: eval_only
- Status reasons: fixture mode is always eval_only (the checks alone would give validated_with_warnings); the review passed in round 2 with warnings on item 21 and no unresolved issues.
- Known limitations: The capture is complete (method html) with no recorded capture limitations, but it covers one page in one default state (one invoice row, INV-3301); no empty, loading, error, confirmation or disabled states, and no invoice statuses, are visible. Research ran in fixture mode with live search disabled (4 search stubs, 1 fetch); the only source describes itself as a test fixture and not real documentation, although the findings label it official documentation. For GAP-001 both findings were dropped in verification and for GAP-003 no findings were produced, so no research evidence supports this specification. No technical documents were supplied.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: none recorded by the review. Outstanding decisions: Q-001 (finance administrator role and what other users see), Q-002 (who may view and restore deleted invoices), Q-003 (legal or accounting retention of invoices), Q-004 (Excel export scope, file type, fields, placement, permissions), Q-005 (reach of permanent removal and how the 30 days are counted), Q-006 (effect of deleted-but-recoverable invoices on balances, reports and the list). Q-001 to Q-006 are blocking; Q-007 and Q-008 are non-blocking.

## 2. Executive Summary

The customer wants an Invoices screen where invoices can be deleted, recovered for a limited time, and exported. Their requirements arrived with three contradictions: who may delete, whether export is PDF only or also Excel, and whether deletion is permanent at once or recoverable for 30 days. The answers recorded at checkpoint 1 are that only finance administrators delete invoices (DEC-001), both PDF and Excel exports are needed (DEC-002), and deleted invoices are recoverable for 30 days and then removed permanently (DEC-003). The requirement records still carry the label Conflicting, so this document states those answers as recorded and does not treat them as settled beyond that.

The mockup shows one screen with a one-row table and row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons that lead nowhere. It shows nothing for Excel export, restoring deleted invoices, confirmation, or success and failure messages.

Key open decisions: who the finance administrators are and what other users see; who can restore deleted invoices and where; whether invoices must legally be kept (invoices are financial records and the run assumed a UK context from GBP amounts); the scope and file type of Excel export; how far permanent removal reaches and how the 30 days are counted; and how deleted invoices affect balances and reports. Research produced no usable evidence for these, so they are put to the customer rather than answered here.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Let finance administrators delete invoices from the Invoices screen, as recorded in the customer requirements and DEC-001.
- Keep deleted invoices recoverable for 30 days and then remove them permanently, as recorded in DEC-003.
- Provide invoice export in both PDF and Excel formats, as recorded in DEC-002.
- Resolve the approved gaps (GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-003, GAP-004, GAP-006, GAP-009, GAP-011, GAP-012) with the customer before build.

### In Scope

- Invoice deletion restricted to finance administrators.
- Recovery of a deleted invoice within 30 days, and permanent removal after that.
- PDF export and Excel export of invoices.
- The approved gaps listed above, as open items to be resolved.

### Out of Scope / Rejected

No decision rejected any item and the customer excluded nothing. Exclusions are not inferred from what the mockup omits.

### Deferred

- GAP-005, delete confirmation and invoice-state restrictions (Deferred: DEC-005).
- GAP-007, audit trail for delete, restore and permanent removal (Deferred: DEC-005).
- GAP-008, PDF export content, delivery and permissions (Deferred: DEC-005).
- GAP-010, accessibility of row actions in the invoices table (Deferred: DEC-005).

## 4. Users and Roles

- Finance administrator: the only role recorded as allowed to delete invoices (DEC-001). Who holds the role and how it is granted or removed is not defined (Q-001).
- Other users: recorded as unable to delete invoices (DEC-001). Whether they may view or export invoices is not stated.
- Who may restore deleted invoices and who may export are unknown (Q-002, Q-004).
- The invoice creator is mentioned in the customer's line 2 only (REQ-002); see FR-002.

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

- Capture: one page ("Invoices"), method html, fixture mode, status complete. Screens: SCR-001 (Invoices). Components: SCR-002 (invoices table).
- Observed table columns: Invoice, Customer, Amount and an unlabelled actions column. One row: INV-3301, Northwind, £1,200, with row-level Delete and Export PDF buttons, both enabled.
- Flows: Delete (SCR-003) and Export PDF (SCR-004) buttons have no link or handler and no destination.
- Observed state: default only.
- Ambiguous behaviours the capture cannot answer: who can delete; confirmation before Delete; permanent or undoable; deletion by invoice status; delete failure; downstream effects; who can export a PDF; PDF content and delivery; export failure; export by invoice state.
- Not shown: Excel export, any view of deleted invoices or restore action, empty, loading, error, confirmation and disabled states, invoice statuses.

## 6. Requirements Traceability

| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-001 | Only finance administrators can delete invoices. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-001, FR-007, AC-001, AC-002, DEC-001, Q-001 |
| REQ-002 | Any user can delete invoices they created. | unresolved | Conflicting | FR-002, DEC-001, ASM-G-001, ASM-F-001 |
| REQ-003 | Invoices must be exported as PDF only. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-011, FR-013, DEC-002, ASM-F-002 |
| REQ-004 | Users must be able to export invoices to Excel. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-012, FR-013, FR-014, FR-015, AC-005, AC-006, DEC-002, Q-004 |
| REQ-005 | Deleted invoices are removed permanently. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-004, BR-002, BR-003, AC-004, DEC-003, Q-003, Q-005 |
| REQ-006 | Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-003, FR-005, AC-003, DEC-003, DEC-004, Q-002 |

## 7. Gaps Identified

| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GAP-001 | Excel export not represented in the mockup | approved (DEC-005) | both | critical | open (researched; no kept findings; customer decision pending) | Must-have export with no shown trigger, scope or fields. |
